mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9) which increase isoniazid metabolism, potentially reducing isoniazid efficacy; isoniazid may also inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism leading to increased eslicarbazepine levels.
action: Monitor serum isoniazid and eslicarbazepine levels; ensure adequate TB treatment efficacy while assessing for eslicarbazepine toxicity; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible or adjust dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
